question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, military, and security apparatus underpins the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Ongoing personnel purges, including recent leadership changes in the People’s Liberation Army, have further centralized authority, while the absence of a publicly designated successor reduces pressure for an early transition ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Credible reporting shows preparations for a fourth term extending into the 2030s, with limited visible factional challenges capable of forcing an exit. Realistic scenarios that could still shift probabilities include sudden health developments, severe economic or diplomatic crises eroding elite support, or unexpected internal maneuvering before the congress concludes.
